common_uses: Used for temporary relief of mild to moderate pain and reduction of fever.
common_side_effects: Usually well tolerated when used as directed.
serious_warnings: Taking more than recommended can cause serious liver damage.
important_precautions: Do not exceed the recommended dose. Check other medicines for acetaminophen. Tell a healthcare professional if you have liver disease.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used for mild to moderate pain, fever, inflammation, and certain types of arthritis.
common_side_effects: May cause stomach discomfort, nausea, indigestion, or dizziness.
serious_warnings: NSAIDs can increase the risk of heart attack or stroke and can cause serious stomach or intestinal bleeding.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about heart disease, kidney disease, ulcers, or bleeding problems. Do not combine with other NSAIDs unless advised.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to treat certain bacterial infections, including some respiratory, skin, and urinary tract infections.
common_side_effects: May cause nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.
serious_warnings: Serious allergic reactions can occur. Antibiotic-associated severe diarrhea can also occur.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about penicillin allergies, kidney disease, or other medical conditions. Take exactly as prescribed.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to treat certain bacterial infections.
common_side_effects: May cause nausea, diarrhea, stomach discomfort, or vomiting.
serious_warnings: May cause serious heart rhythm problems in susceptible patients and serious allergic reactions.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about heart rhythm problems, liver disease, or other medicines being taken.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to control high blood sugar in people with type 2 diabetes.
common_side_effects: May cause diarrhea, nausea, stomach discomfort, or gas.
serious_warnings: Rarely, metformin can cause a serious condition called lactic acidosis.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about kidney, liver, or heart problems and all medicines being taken.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to treat gastroesophageal reflux disease, certain ulcers, and conditions involving excessive stomach acid.
common_side_effects: May cause headache, nausea, abdominal discomfort, or diarrhea.
serious_warnings: Long-term or high-dose use may be associated with serious adverse effects and drug interactions.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about all medicines being taken and any persistent or worsening symptoms.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to relieve allergy symptoms and treat hives.
common_side_effects: May cause drowsiness, tiredness, or dry mouth.
serious_warnings: Serious allergic reactions can occur. Severe itching has rarely been reported after stopping long-term use.
important_precautions: May cause drowsiness. Tell a healthcare professional about other medicines being taken.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to relieve sneezing, runny nose, and itchy or watery eyes caused by allergies.
common_side_effects: May cause headache, drowsiness, tiredness, or dry mouth.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about kidney or liver disease and other medicines being taken. Do not exceed the recommended amount.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used for pain, fever, inflammation, and for prevention of certain cardiovascular events when medically indicated.
common_side_effects: May cause stomach irritation, nausea, or heartburn.
serious_warnings: Can cause serious gastrointestinal bleeding and increased bleeding risk.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about ulcers, bleeding disorders, or blood-thinning medicines. Aspirin should not routinely be given to children or teenagers with certain viral illnesses.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to relieve pain and inflammation and to treat certain types of arthritis and menstrual pain.
common_side_effects: May cause stomach upset, nausea, or heartburn.
serious_warnings: May increase the risk of heart attack or stroke and can cause serious stomach or intestinal bleeding.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about heart disease, kidney disease, ulcers, or bleeding problems.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to treat certain bacterial infections, acne, and rosacea, and to prevent malaria in appropriate circumstances.
common_side_effects: May cause nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, or increased sensitivity to sunlight.
serious_warnings: Serious allergic reactions and severe skin reactions can occur.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about pregnancy or plans for pregnancy. Follow instructions regarding water, food, and mineral-containing products.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to treat certain bacterial infections.
common_side_effects: May cause nausea, diarrhea, dizziness, or headache.
serious_warnings: Can increase the risk of tendinitis and tendon rupture and can cause serious nervous-system effects.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about tendon problems, heart rhythm problems, or other medicines and supplements being taken.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to treat certain bacterial infections.
common_side_effects: May cause diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, gas, or heartburn.
serious_warnings: Serious allergic reactions can occur. Severe or bloody diarrhea can occur during or after treatment.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about allergies to cefixime or related antibiotics and about kidney, liver, or gastrointestinal disease.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to treat certain fungal and yeast infections and to prevent certain fungal infections in high-risk patients.
common_side_effects: May cause headache, nausea, stomach pain, or diarrhea.
serious_warnings: Can cause serious liver problems and serious allergic or skin reactions.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about liver disease, allergies, pregnancy, and all medicines being taken.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to lower cholesterol and reduce the risk of certain cardiovascular events.
common_side_effects: May cause diarrhea, joint pain, or muscle pain.
serious_warnings: Can cause serious muscle injury and liver problems.
important_precautions: Report unexplained muscle pain or weakness. Tell a healthcare professional about liver disease and all medicines being taken.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to treat high blood pressure and certain kidney problems associated with type 2 diabetes and hypertension.
common_side_effects: May cause dizziness, back pain, or upper respiratory symptoms.
serious_warnings: Can cause serious fetal harm or death when used during pregnancy.
important_precautions: Do not use during pregnancy. Tell a healthcare professional about kidney disease and all medicines or supplements being taken.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.

common_uses: Used to treat high blood pressure and certain types of angina and coronary artery disease.
common_side_effects: May cause swelling of the ankles or feet, dizziness, or flushing.
serious_warnings: Serious cardiovascular effects can occur in some patients.
important_precautions: Tell a healthcare professional about heart failure, heart disease, liver disease, and other medicines being taken.
information_verification: Verified against MedlinePlus Drug Information on 2026-09-10.
